summary: The source captures iterations launchSpmv calls into a CUDA graph before timed events are recorded. Timed execution launches the captured graph once, which replays the captured repeated SpMV work. I verified the compiled capture loop and its iterations backedge precede the timed event record/graph launch. The complete compiled dispatcher reaches both thread- and warp-kernel stubs, and each stub calls cudaLaunchKernel. Both selected sm_86 SASS kernels traverse CSR work and store outputs. MPI partitions cover contiguous complete rows and their matching full CSR intervals, with locally rebased delimiters.
